reason: Most of what I get is cafés offering a free meal for a reel, so there's no rate to negotiate and no payment to chase. I might poke at the free scam check, but I'm not paying for Pro or giving 5% when I already apply through Influish and wait.
objection: A tool that tells me my 'fair rate' doesn't help when the brands at my size only offer barter. And I'm not sure I want an AI sending payment reminders from my account to the few brands that do pay me.
would_change_my_mind: If Mitra actually brought me paid collabs from Bengaluru brands, or showed me that barter-only cafés switched to cash after I sent its counter-offer.
